takes.title: Steady jog across the capture space
takes.actionDescription: The performer moves through successive jogging strides with compact arm swings, staying at a steady cadence through the last pose.
takes.reviewNote: Source starts with 55 all-zero captured frames. First usable motion is recorded at source frame 56.

takes.title: Neutral walk with even footfalls
takes.actionDescription: The performer walks through several even steps with relaxed shoulders, a narrow stance, and a small alternating arm swing.

takes.title: Stiff walk with arms forward
takes.actionDescription: The performer holds both arms out in front, takes measured strides with a stiff upper body, and keeps the arms raised through the end.

takes.title: Continuous jog with high heel recovery
takes.actionDescription: The performer jogs throughout the take with bent elbows, lifting each heel behind on alternating strides.

takes.title: Short jog into a stand
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts upright, builds into a short sequence of jogging steps, then slows and settles with the feet apart.

takes.title: Start jogging from standing
takes.actionDescription: The performer shifts forward from a relaxed stance, bends the elbows, and accelerates into a jog that continues through the finish.

takes.title: Standing weight shifts and arm gestures
takes.actionDescription: The performer changes between hands at the waist and hands near the chest, turns the head and shoulders, and settles with the arms lowered.

takes.title: Jog start with a preparatory lean
takes.actionDescription: The performer pauses with feet planted, leans forward into the first step, then establishes a quicker jogging cadence with bent arms.

takes.title: Jog to a relaxed stand
takes.actionDescription: The performer begins mid-jog, shortens the last few steps, and lets the arms drop while coming upright.

takes.title: Jog to a wide-foot stop
takes.actionDescription: The performer transitions from springy running strides to short braking steps, finishes with the feet apart, and lowers the hands.

takes.title: Bouncy walk with sweeping gestures
takes.actionDescription: The performer takes exaggerated springing steps, alternates high leg swings and broad arm reaches, and keeps moving through the finish.

takes.title: Excited walk with high steps and reaches
takes.actionDescription: The performer bounds forward with high knees, dips and extends both arms out, then adds an overhead reach in the last few steps.

takes.title: Staggering walk with repeated catches
takes.actionDescription: The performer lurches through uneven steps, throws the arms out and up to recover, and finishes with another forward lean and cross-step.

takes.title: Exaggerated walk start
takes.actionDescription: The performer pauses upright, starts with a high step and a diagonal arm reach, then accelerates with forward leans and springing steps.

takes.title: Staggered stance with both arms forward
takes.actionDescription: The performer keeps the arms lifted in front and the knees soft, holding a near-static staggered stance.

takes.title: Erratic traveling gait
takes.actionDescription: The performer leans and pitches through long, uneven steps, swinging one arm overhead and reaching the other outward for balance.

takes.title: Erratic gait into an upright stop
takes.actionDescription: The performer enters with a long lurching step and one arm raised, corrects with smaller crossing steps, and comes to a stand.

takes.title: Lurching steps into a stop
takes.actionDescription: After the opening reference frames, the performer travels with exaggerated arm reaches and forward bends, then shortens the steps and settles upright.
takes.reviewNote: Source starts with 113 all-zero captured frames. First usable motion is recorded at source frame 114.
